{F : Type} → [inst : Field F] → {v : ℕ} → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → (ℕ → Polynomial F) → F → F → (Fin v → F) → Prop := fun {F} [Field F] {v} prover honest H S r => (∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (prover i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (prover i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain H prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) ∧ Minidregg.Selvage.scChain H prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) v = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain S honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) v

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] {v : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {H S : F} {r : Fin v → F}, Minidregg.Selvage.AcceptsFalse prover honest H S r ↔ Minidregg.Selvage.SumcheckAccepts prover honest H S r ∧ H ≠ S

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {v d : ℕ} {prover honest : (ℕ → F) → ℕ → Polynomial F} {f : ι → F} {c : Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F}, ¬Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c → Minidregg.Selvage.PrefixMeasurable prover → Minidregg.Selvage.PrefixMeasurable honest → (∀ (χ : ℕ → F), ∀ i < v, (prover χ i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (χ : ℕ → F), ∀ i < v, (honest χ i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (r : Fin v → F), ∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum c f) (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r)) (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) fun r => Minidregg.Selvage.SumcheckAccepts (prover (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r)) (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r)) c.target (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum c f) r) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {v d : ℕ} {prover honest : (ℕ → F) → ℕ → Polynomial F} {H S : F}, Minidregg.Selvage.PrefixMeasurable prover → Minidregg.Selvage.PrefixMeasurable honest → (∀ (χ : ℕ → F), ∀ i < v, (prover χ i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (χ : ℕ → F), ∀ i < v, (honest χ i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (r : Fin v → F), ∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain S (honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r)) (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) → Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) (Minidregg.Selvage.AdaptiveAcceptsFalse prover honest H S) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {f : ι → F} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)}, (∃ c ∈ cs, ¬Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c) → (Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb F fun γ => Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs)) ≤ ↑(cs.length - 1) / ↑(Fintype.card F)
{ι : Type u_1} → {F : Type} → [Field F] → Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F → (ι → F) → ι → F

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] {v : ℕ} (e : ι ≃ (Fin v → Bool)) (f : ι → F) (c : Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F), Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c ↔ ∑ b, Minidregg.Selvage.constraintSummand c f (e.symm b) = c.target

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] (f : ι → F) (c : Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F), Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c ↔ ∑ i, Minidregg.Selvage.constraintSummand c f i = c.target

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [inst_2 : DecidableEq F] {v d : ℕ} {prover honest : (ℕ → F) → ℕ → Polynomial F}, (∀ (χ : ℕ → F), ∀ i < v, (prover χ i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (χ : ℕ → F), ∀ i < v, (honest χ i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → ∀ (r : Fin v → F) (i : Fin v), (Minidregg.Selvage.launderSet prover honest r i).card ≤ d

∀ {F : Type} [inst : Field F] [inst_1 : Fintype F] [inst_2 : DecidableEq F] {v : ℕ} {prover honest : (ℕ → F) → ℕ → Polynomial F}, Minidregg.Selvage.PrefixMeasurable prover → Minidregg.Selvage.PrefixMeasurable honest → ∀ (i : Fin v) (r r' : Fin v → F), (∀ (j : Fin v), ↑j < ↑i → r j = r' j) → Minidregg.Selvage.launderSet prover honest r i = Minidregg.Selvage.launderSet prover honest r' i

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] (γ : F) {f : ι → F} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)}, (∀ c ∈ cs, Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c) → ∑ i, Minidregg.Selvage.constraintSummand (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs) f i = (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs).target

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] {v : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {f : ι → F} {c : Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F}, Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c → ∀ (r : Fin v → F), ¬Minidregg.Selvage.AcceptsFalse prover honest c.target (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum c f) r

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {v d : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {f : ι → F} {cs : List (Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F)} {γ : F}, ¬Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs) → (∀ i < v, (prover i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ i < v, (honest i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (r : Fin v → F), ∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (honest i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (honest i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs) f) honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) → Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) (Minidregg.Selvage.SumcheckAccepts prover honest (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs).target (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum (Minidregg.Selvage.batchConstraint γ cs) f)) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))

∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] {F : Type} [inst_1 : Field F] [inst_2 : Fintype F] [DecidableEq F] {v d : ℕ} {prover honest : ℕ → Polynomial F} {f : ι → F} {c : Minidregg.Selvage.LinearConstraint ι F}, ¬Minidregg.Selvage.Satisfies f c → (∀ i < v, (prover i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ i < v, (honest i).degree < ↑(d + 1)) → (∀ (r : Fin v → F), ∀ i < v, Polynomial.eval 0 (honest i) + Polynomial.eval 1 (honest i) = Minidregg.Selvage.scChain (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum c f) honest (Minidregg.Selvage.chalOf r) i) → Minidregg.Selvage.uniformProb (Fin v → F) (Minidregg.Selvage.SumcheckAccepts prover honest c.target (Minidregg.Selvage.trueSum c f)) ≤ ↑v * (↑d / ↑(Fintype.card F))
